residency_notes: Venice does not publish a fixed geographic execution or data-residency location for E2EE models. Prompts are encrypted on the client and decrypted only inside a verified TEE; operational metadata is still processed separately from prompt and response content.
prompt_training_notes: Venice's E2EE mode encrypts prompts on the client and decrypts them only inside a verified TEE, on top of Venice's normal no-content-retention proxy architecture. Operational metadata is still processed.
